faq.a: King + Crescent at 146A Street and King George Boulevard (3438 146A Street and neighbouring buildings) was built 2024–2025 by Zenterra Developments, per the MLS® strata building record.
King + Crescent is 6 (four buildings) storeys with 411 homes.

faq.q: What amenities does King + Crescent have?
faq.a: A gym and yoga room, theatre, games room, playground, guest suite and electric car charging. Each home comes with a parking stall and a storage locker.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

blocks.text: A gym and yoga room, theatre, games room, playground, guest suite and electric car charging. Each home comes with a parking stall and a storage locker.
The buildings are near the shops along King George Boulevard and a short drive to Highway 99. Being new, they carry the remaining BC new home warranty; ask the seller for the warranty documents.
Before you buy at King + Crescent

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what King + Crescent owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
